CheckTitle: Ensure BPM Approval Rule and Workflow Configuration Changes Are Audited
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Description: Changes to BPM approval rules and SOA workflow configuration should be audited and reviewed.
Risk: Untracked approval-rule changes can bypass approval hierarchies and separation of duties.
AuditProcedure: Setup and Maintenance > Manage Audit Policies: SOA/BPM audit enabled (Doc ID 2053746.1).
Audit data available and forwarded centrally; recent changes match change requests.

Steps: Enable SOA/BPM auditing, route rule changes through change management and review them regularly.
